```artifact
Feature: Self-Test and Pre-Test Mode Validation

  Scenario: Validate flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to a certain speed
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is performed
    Then the flow sensor should give the expected flow value

  Scenario Outline: Validate pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is performed with a pressure of <pressure>
    Then the pressure sensor should read <expected_reading>
    Examples:
      | pressure | expected_reading |
      | 0        | 0                |
      | 100      | 100              |
      | 200      | 200              |
      | 300      | 300              |
      | 400      | 400              |

  Scenario: Controller supports pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode is activated
    Then the controller should enter pre-test mode

  Scenario: GUI supports controller's pre-test mode
    Given the GUI is displayed
    And the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode button is clicked
    Then the GUI should indicate that the controller is in pre-test mode

  Scenario Outline: Controller's pre-test mode includes checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the pre-test is executed with <condition>
    Then the controller should perform <check>
    Examples:
      | condition          | check                           |
      | flow sensor check  | validate flow sensor accuracy   |
      | pressure sensor check | validate pressure sensor accuracy |
      | system integrity check | verify system integrity       |
```
